title: Barage bi yàq benn royaume
intro: Réew mu bari dex yuy wal, ñaari jardin yu naat, ak naataange gu amul fenn — waaye ñi ci dëkk dañu bàyyi xel ci Ki leen barkeel. Bu ñu leen fàttali ni ñu dellu, ñu wëlbatiku. Li ci topp mooy mbugal gi ba leegi mingi wéy di àrtu. Kan moo nekkoon askan wi fi yàgg a nekk?
clues: Nu dëkkoon ci réew mu barkeel lool, sunu kër nekkoon ci diggante ñaari jardin yu naat.
Nu kontaan lool ci dex yiy wal ci sunuy tool, ak góob yu bari yu fees sunuy kër.
Waaye bi ñu woowe nu gërëm sunu Boroom ak déggal ko, nu dellu ginaaw ci réy-réy.
Sunu alal ak sunu yombaay daf nu fàtte Ki nu jox lépp.
Jekk saa am lu melni ndox mu bari, daal di jàll barrier bu mag bi nu doon wóolu.
Nun waa Sabaa lanu, seen réew ràññeeku woon ci barabu Ma'rib bu mag bi.

trial.label: Sunu Daan
options: Mbënd bu bawoo ci barab buy toj
Ngelaw lu am doole luy joge asamaan
Di féey ci mbënd mu rëy
trial.answer: Mbënd bu bawoo ci barab buy toj

outcome.label: Sunu ëlëg
options: Ñaari jardin yu wex ñoo wecci sunuy jardin yu naat yi
Sunu jardin yi dañu gëna am naat
Suuf si dafa suux ci suufu géej gi
Ñu suul nu ci dóomu wolkaan bi
Sunu réew xaajaloo nekk fukk ak ñaari lakk
outcome.answer: Ñaari jardin yu wex ñoo wecci sunuy jardin yu naat yi

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
